name: Merchant of Doom (Warmage Archetype)
body:
Merchants of doom are the fear-mongers among warmages trained in the dark warfare of instilling fear, breaking morale, and cursing their opponents. They trade in doom and despair.

Class Skills: A merchant of doom adds Perception and Sense Motive as class skills. This ability modifies class skills.

Business Trade: Unlike other warmages, a merchant of doom is not proficient with light shields and cannot cast warmage spells without incurring the normal arcane spell failure while wielding a shield. The merchant of doom gains a bonus equal to their warmage class level on all Profession (merchant or soldier) skill checks they make. This ability alters weapon and armor proficiencies.

Dread Magics (Ex)

A merchant of doom adds the following spells (other than evocation spells) from the bard/skald, witch, and wizard spell lists to their warmage spell list: all spells with the compulsion or haunted subschools and all spells with the curse, despair*, or fear descriptors. They lose access to all evocation spells and they receive one fewer spell slot at each spell level. If this results in no spells per day at a spell level, a merchant of doom can only cast spells of that level if they get them as bonus spells due to a high spellcasting ability modifier. This ability modifies spellcasting.

Dread Mien (Ex)

At 2nd level, a merchant of doom gains a +2 bonus on all demoralize attempts they make and the DC of demoralize attempts against them. This bonus is also applied to any saving throws they make against compulsion, curse, despair, fear, or haunted effects. This bonus increases by +2 at 9th and 16th levels. This ability replaces focused mind and armored mage.

Arcane Strategies: A merchant of doom gains access to the following arcane strategies:

Battle Magics (Ex)

You add an evocation spell available to the wizard to each spell level you possess or later gain, including cantrips, of your spell list. The spell must still be learned and added to your spellbook before it can be used. This arcane strategy can be selected multiple times, gaining new spells for each level.

Dread Reaper (Ex)

From the spells added to your warmage spell list via dread magics, you select one spell per spell level, including cantrips, that you possess or later gain. You can cast the selected spells at a +1 caster level. You may select this arcane strategy multiple times; each time you do, you may either choose to select the same spells to increase the granted CL bonus by +1 or select an additional different qualifying spell to gain a +1 caster level.

Eater of Doom (Su)

When you are under the effects of a compulsion, curse, despair*, fear, or haunted effect with a duration other than instantaneous or permanent, you reduce the penalties imposed by such effects by 1 (to a minimum of -1). Additionally, you gain a +1 competence bonus to attack rolls, weapon damage rolls, and saving throws you make for the same duration. You may select this arcane strategy up to five times; each time increases the penalty reduction by 1 (minimum -1 penalty) and the competence bonus increases by +1 (maximum +5). You can only select this arcane strategy once for every dread reaper arcane strategy you possess.

Paragon of Dread (Ex)

You add a +1 bonus to the save DC of any compulsion, curse, despair*, fear, or haunted effect you create. You may select this arcane strategy up to three times; each time, the bonus increases by +1 (maximum +3). You can only select this arcane strategy once for every dread reaper arcane strategy you possess.

Dreadcraft (Su)

At 4th level, a merchant of doom gains one witch hex of their choice for which they meet the prerequisites; it cannot be a hex only available from an archetype, one that has any curative, restorative, or protective effects (including negating effects), one that affects a witch’s familiar, grants a feat, or is restricted to a patron.

For the purposes of qualifying for any such hex, a merchant of doom’s effective witch class level is equal to 1/2 their warmage class level. However, they use their full warmage class level to determine the effects of the hex. A merchant of doom gains another witch hex at 12th and 20th level.

This ability replaces the bonus feats gained at 4th, 12th, and 20th levels.

Dread Wrack: Starting at 6th level, a merchant of doom gains any one blood hex feat (Magic Tactics Toolbox, page 28) for which they meet the prerequisites as a bonus feat. A merchant of doom is treated as a witch for determining the effects of any blood hex feat they use. They gain an additional blood hex feat in this manner at 10th, 14th, and 18th levels. This ability replaces sudden empower, sudden enlarge, sudden widen, and sudden maximize.

Dread Avatar (Ex)

At 20th level, a merchant of doom has become the epitome of fear in the hearts of their enemies and has conquered their own weaknesses. A merchant of death is immune to compulsion, curse, despair* (see above), fear, and haunted effects, unless they wish to be affected. This ability replaces war incarnate.
